description: List all stored PDF drafts in this session. Returns previews[{preview_id, title}], count, and most_recent_preview_id. Use when the user taps List PDFs or asks which drafts exist. Does not show document body — follow with get_preview after they pick.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: pdf__list_previews
